title: Wilson meeting at the EG&G parking lot where Bob Lazar worked

tellings.quote: that meeting took place in the parking lot & which is where Bob Lazar I pretty sure worked

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the Wilson memo, a set of notes said to record a 2002 meeting between a physicist, Eric Davis, and a Navy admiral, Thomas J. Wilson, about secret programs studying unexplained craft. Michels says the meeting took place in a parking lot belonging to EG&G, a defense contractor, which he believes is where Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft, was employed. If so, it would tie two of the best-known stories in this field to the same spot.
